description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable JsonWebKey class, including methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and for accessing key properties.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonWebKey
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the JsonWebKey interface, representing a JSON Web Key with properties like type, algorithm, usage, id, modulus, and exponent.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new JsonWebKey instance with specified parameters, validating non-empty and non-null arguments.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a JsonWebKey instance from a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a JsonWebKey instance from a JsonObject, extracting required fields and decoding base64-encoded modulus and exponent.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the JSON Web Key.

methods.name: getAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the algorithm of the key, if present.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the usage of the key, if present.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the key.

methods.name: getModulus
methods.description: Returns the modulus component of the key.

methods.name: getExponent
methods.description: Returns the exponent component of the key.
